'''Chihiro Ueda''' (Japanese: '''植田千尋''' ''Ueda Chihiro'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Ueda was born sometime on February 28, in {{wp|Osaka Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. She started work on {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|JN}}, where she voiced recurring character [[Parker]].

==Pokémon roles==
===Animation===

* [[Parker]]

* Masaru Saiga (''Karakuri Circus'')
